key_columns.description: Account Type (D=Customer, K=Vendor, S=GL, A=Asset, M=Material)

source_tables.description: Invoice Verification Document Line Items (Logistics Invoice Verification)

key_columns.description: Date on which record was created
Date on which record was created

source_tables.description: Sales Document Flow (links SO → Delivery → Billing → Accounting)

key_columns.description: Document Category Preceding (A=Inquiry, B=Quotation, C=Order, J=Delivery, M=Invoice)

processes.name: Accounts Payable
processes.description: Tracks vendor invoice lifecycle from creation or scanning through payment clearing.

case_definition.description: One case per accounting document header where account type is Vendor (KOART = 'K')

activities.name: Create Invoice
activities.description: Vendor invoice first posted in SAP (transaction MIRO or FB60)
activities.trigger: First posting of document with BLART = invoice type (e.g. RE, KR)

activities.name: Scan Invoice
activities.description: Invoice captured via OCR or document management system before SAP entry
activities.trigger: OCR document creation timestamp

activities.name: Enter in SAP
activities.description: Invoice manually keyed into SAP
activities.trigger: TCODE = FB60 / MIRO and first creation of document

activities.name: Change Invoice
activities.description: Vendor invoice header or line item amended after posting
activities.trigger: Change document created for OBJECTCLAS = BELEG

activities.name: Set Payment Block
activities.description: Payment block flag set on vendor open item
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' and VALUE_NEW is not empty

activities.name: Release Payment Block
activities.description: Payment block removed from vendor open item
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' and VALUE_NEW is empty

activities.name: Due Date
activities.description: Payment due date milestone — calculated from baseline date and payment terms
activities.trigger: Derived from ZFBDT + net payment days from payment terms

activities.name: Cash Discount Due Date
activities.description: Last day to take cash discount
activities.trigger: Derived from ZFBDT + ZBD1T days

activities.name: Clear Invoice
activities.description: Vendor invoice cleared — payment posted and matched to invoice
activities.trigger: BSEG.AUGBL is populated (clearing document assigned)

activities.name: Check Issued
activities.description: Payment check generated and issued
activities.trigger: Payment run creates PAYR record

activities.name: Check Encashment
activities.description: Issued check encashed by vendor
activities.trigger: Bank statement processed and check cleared

activities.name: Vendor Master Change (General)
activities.description: LFA1 vendor general data changed (name, address, etc.)
activities.trigger: OBJECTCLAS = 'KRED', change to LFA1 fields

activities.name: Vendor Master Change (Company Code)
activities.description: LFB1 vendor company code data changed (payment terms, payment method)
activities.trigger: OBJECTCLAS = 'KRED', change to LFB1 fields

processes.name: Accounts Receivable
processes.description: Tracks customer invoice lifecycle from creation through payment clearing, including dunning and credit management.

case_definition.description: One case per accounting document where account type is Customer (KOART = 'D')

activities.name: Create Invoice
activities.description: Customer invoice created (transaction VF01 or FB70)
activities.trigger: First posting of customer document (BLART = DR, RV, etc.)

activities.name: Enter in SAP
activities.description: Customer invoice manually entered into SAP FI
activities.trigger: TCODE = FB70 and first creation

activities.name: Cancel Invoice
activities.description: Customer invoice cancelled/reversed
activities.trigger: Reversal document: STBLG is populated on original, or new document references original

activities.name: Clear Invoice
activities.description: Customer invoice cleared — incoming payment matched
activities.trigger: BSEG.AUGBL populated (clearing document number assigned)

activities.name: Dunning
activities.description: Dunning notice issued for overdue invoice
activities.trigger: KNB5.MADAT updated by dunning run (F150)

activities.name: Overdue Notice
activities.description: Overdue payment notice sent to customer
activities.trigger: Dunning correspondence generated

activities.name: Due Date Passed
activities.description: Invoice due date has passed without payment
activities.trigger: Derived — net due date < current date and AUGDT is null

activities.name: Cash Discount Due Date Passed
activities.description: Cash discount window has expired
activities.trigger: Derived — ZBD1T days from ZFBDT

activities.name: Change Payment Block
activities.description: Payment block on customer open item changed
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'MANSP' changed

activities.name: Change Payment Terms
activities.description: Payment terms on customer changed
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZTERM' changed on KNB1 or document

activities.name: Change Credit Control Amount
activities.description: Customer credit limit or exposure updated
activities.trigger: Change to KNKK fields (KLIMK, SKFOR, CRBLB)

activities.name: Record Goods Issue
activities.description: Goods issued against delivery for customer order
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 601 (goods issue for delivery)

processes.name: Procure to Pay
processes.description: End-to-end procurement process from purchase requisition through purchase order, goods receipt, invoice verification, and payment.

case_definition.description: One case per Purchase Order. Item-level variant uses EBELN + EBELP as case key.

activities.name: Create Purchase Requisition
activities.description: Purchase Requisition created (manually or via MRP)
activities.trigger: New EBAN record created (transaction ME51N or automatic MRP run)

activities.name: Change Purchase Requisition
activities.description: Purchase Requisition header or item amended
activities.trigger: Change document for OBJECTCLAS = BANF

activities.name: Release Purchase Requisition
activities.description: Purchase Requisition approved/released through release strategy
activities.trigger: EBAN.FRGKZ changes to released state

activities.name: Refuse Purchase Requisition
activities.description: Purchase Requisition rejected in release strategy
activities.trigger: EBAN release indicator set to rejected

activities.name: Create Purchase Order Item
activities.description: Purchase Order created referencing PR or directly (transaction ME21N)
activities.trigger: New EKKO / EKPO record created

activities.name: Change Purchase Order
activities.description: PO header data changed
activities.trigger: Change document for OBJECTCLAS = EINKBELEG

activities.name: Change Purchase Order Item
activities.description: PO line item data changed (price, quantity, delivery date)
activities.trigger: CDPOS changes on EKPO fields

activities.name: Change Schedule Line
activities.description: PO schedule line delivery date or quantity changed
activities.trigger: CDPOS changes on EKET fields

activities.name: PO Approval Step
activities.description: Purchase Order release strategy approval step completed
activities.trigger: EKKO.FRGKE changes to approved / next release level

activities.name: Record Goods Receipt
activities.description: Goods received against purchase order (transaction MIGO, movement type 101)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 101 and EBELN is populated

activities.name: First Invoice Created
activities.description: First vendor invoice posted referencing the PO
activities.trigger: EKBE.VGABE = 2 (invoice posting) — first occurrence per PO

activities.name: Clear Invoice
activities.description: Vendor invoice cleared through payment
activities.trigger: BSEG.AUGBL populated for vendor invoice line

activities.name: Payment Block
activities.description: Payment block set or removed on vendor invoice
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'ZLSPR' changed on invoice document

activities.name: Order Messages
activities.description: Purchase Order output message sent to vendor (email, EDI, print)
activities.trigger: NAST record with KAPPL = EF (Purchasing) and sent status

processes.name: Order to Cash
processes.description: End-to-end process from sales order creation through delivery, billing, and cash receipt.

case_definition.description: One case per Sales Order header. Document flow (VBFA) links to delivery, billing, and accounting documents.

activities.name: Create Sales Order
activities.description: Sales order header created (transaction VA01)
activities.trigger: New VBAK record created

activities.name: Create Sales Order Item
activities.description: Sales order line item created
activities.trigger: New VBAP record created

activities.name: Change Sales Order
activities.description: Sales order header data changed
activities.trigger: Change document for OBJECTCLAS = VERKBELEG on VBAK level

activities.name: Change Sales Order Item
activities.description: Sales order item data changed (quantity, price, delivery date)
activities.trigger: CDPOS changes on VBAP fields

activities.name: Change Schedule Lines
activities.description: Delivery schedule line changed
activities.trigger: CDPOS changes on VBEP fields

activities.name: Credit Check
activities.description: Credit limit check run for customer
activities.trigger: Credit check performed — KNKK credit exposure evaluated

activities.name: Record Goods Issue
activities.description: Goods issued for outbound delivery (movement type 601)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 601 and delivery (LIKP) goods issue date populated

activities.name: Cancel Goods Issue
activities.description: Goods issue reversal posted
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 602 (reversal of goods issue)

activities.name: Sales Order Status Change
activities.description: Overall processing status of sales order changed
activities.trigger: VBAK.GBSTK changes (A=Not processed, B=Partially, C=Fully processed)

processes.name: Billing
processes.description: SD billing document lifecycle from creation to customer payment clearing.

case_definition.description: One case per billing document header (VBRK)

activities.name: Create Billing Document
activities.description: Billing document header created (transaction VF01)
activities.trigger: New VBRK record created

activities.name: Create Billing Item
activities.description: Billing document item created
activities.trigger: New VBRP record created

activities.name: Change Billing Document
activities.description: Billing document header changed
activities.trigger: Change document on VBRK

activities.name: Change Billing Item
activities.description: Billing document item changed
activities.trigger: Change document on VBRP fields

activities.name: Post Billing Document
activities.description: Billing document posted to Financial Accounting — creates FI document
activities.trigger: BKPF document created with reference to VBRK (XBLNR = VBELN)

activities.name: Clear Invoice
activities.description: Customer invoice cleared by incoming payment
activities.trigger: BSEG.AUGBL populated on customer FI line item

processes.name: Record to Report
processes.description: GL journal entry lifecycle — posting, review, approval, and potential reversal of general ledger documents.

case_definition.description: One case per accounting document where account type is GL (KOART = 'S')

activities.name: Post Journal Entry
activities.description: GL journal entry posted (transaction FB50, F-02, FB01)
activities.trigger: New BKPF created with KOART = 'S' lines

activities.name: Change Journal Entry
activities.description: Posted journal entry amended (limited fields editable after posting)
activities.trigger: Change document created for OBJECTCLAS = BELEG

activities.name: Reverse Journal Entry
activities.description: Journal entry reversed (creates a new document with opposite postings)
activities.trigger: BKPF.STBLG is populated on original — reversal document links back

activities.name: GL Account Master Change
activities.description: G/L account master data changed
activities.trigger: Change document on SKA1 / SKB1 (OBJECTCLAS = GLACCOUNT)

processes.name: Batch Lifecycle
processes.description: Pharmaceutical or chemical batch lifecycle from creation through production, goods movements, quality inspection, and dispatch.

case_definition.description: One case per batch (material / plant / batch number combination)

activities.name: Create Batch
activities.description: Batch master record created in SAP (transaction MSC1N or automatic on GR)
activities.trigger: New MCHA record created

activities.name: Create Purchase Order
activities.description: Purchase order created to procure raw material for this batch
activities.trigger: EKKO created for material linked to batch

activities.name: Change Purchase Order
activities.description: Purchase order header changed
activities.trigger: Change document on EKKO (OBJECTCLAS = EINKBELEG)

activities.name: Change Purchase Order Item
activities.description: Purchase order item changed
activities.trigger: Change document on EKPO fields

activities.name: Goods Receipt
activities.description: Raw material or batch goods receipt posted (movement type 101)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 101 and MSEG.CHARG matches batch

activities.name: Planned Goods Movement
activities.description: MRP-planned goods movement milestone
activities.trigger: EKPO.EINDT — planned delivery date from PO

activities.name: Start Production Order
activities.description: Production order status set to Started (AFKO.GSTRS populated or status flag set)
activities.trigger: AUFK status changes to I0003 (Released) or I0010 (Started)

activities.name: Scheduled Start Production Order
activities.description: Planned start date for production order
activities.trigger: AFKO.GSTRP — planned start date from order

activities.name: Scheduled Finish Production Order
activities.description: Planned finish date for production order
activities.trigger: AFKO.GLTRP — planned finish date from order

activities.name: Finish Production Order
activities.description: Production order technically completed
activities.trigger: AUFK status changes to I0045 (Technically Completed) or GLTRS populated

activities.name: Goods Issue to Production
activities.description: Raw materials issued to production order (movement type 261)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 261 and MSEG.AUFNR is populated

activities.name: Quality Release
activities.description: Batch released from quality inspection stock to unrestricted (movement type 321)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 321 and MSEG.CHARG matches batch

activities.name: Create Delivery Document
activities.description: Outbound delivery created to ship batch to customer
activities.trigger: LIKP created with reference to sales order, LIPS.CHARG matches batch

activities.name: Deliver Goods
activities.description: Goods dispatched — goods issue posted against delivery (movement type 601)
activities.trigger: LIKP.WADAT_IST populated (actual goods issue date)

activities.name: Create Movement Type Document
activities.description: Any other goods movement document posted for this batch
activities.trigger: MSEG with CHARG matching batch and any other BWART

processes.name: Production Order
processes.description: Manufacturing production order lifecycle from creation through operations, goods movements, quality inspection, and completion.

activities.name: Create Production Order
activities.description: Production order created (transaction CO01 or via MRP conversion of planned order)
activities.trigger: New AUFK record created with AUART = process/production order type

activities.name: Scheduled Start Production Order
activities.description: Planned start date for the production order
activities.trigger: AFKO.GSTRP — scheduled start from order planning

activities.name: Scheduled Finish Production Order
activities.description: Planned finish date for the production order
activities.trigger: AFKO.GLTRP — scheduled finish from order planning

activities.name: Start Production Order
activities.description: Production order actually started — status set to Started
activities.trigger: AUFK system status includes I0010 (Partly delivered) or GSTRS populated via confirmation

activities.name: Start Operation
activities.description: Individual routing operation started in production
activities.trigger: Operation confirmation posted (transaction CO11N)

activities.name: End Operation
activities.description: Individual routing operation completed
activities.trigger: Operation confirmation with final confirmation flag

activities.name: Material Movement
activities.description: Any goods movement against the production order (GI, GR, reversal)
activities.trigger: MSEG.AUFNR = production order number

activities.name: Goods Issue to Order
activities.description: Components issued to production order (movement type 261)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 261 and MSEG.AUFNR populated

activities.name: Goods Receipt from Order
activities.description: Finished goods received from production order (movement type 101)
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 101 and MSEG.AUFNR populated

activities.name: Inspection End
activities.description: Quality inspection for production order completed
activities.trigger: MSEG.BWART = 321 (quality stock to unrestricted) for production batch

activities.name: Production Order Status Change
activities.description: Order system status changes (Created → Released → Started → Completed → Technically Closed)
activities.trigger: Status object (AUFK.OBJNR) status history changes

activities.name: Finish Production Order
activities.description: Production order technically completed
activities.trigger: AUFK status I0045 (Technically Completed) set, GLTRS populated

activities.name: Create Production Order Item
activities.description: Component item (AFPO) created or modified in the order
activities.trigger: New AFPO record created for the order

processes.name: Material Master Creation
processes.description: Material master data creation process — from initial request through approval (MDG workflow) to activation across all SAP organizational levels.

activities.name: Material Created
activities.description: Material master basic record created in SAP (transaction MM01)
activities.trigger: New MARA record created

activities.name: Plant Data Extended
activities.description: Material extended to a plant — MARC record created
activities.trigger: New MARC record created for MATNR + WERKS

activities.name: Material Master Change
activities.description: Material master field changed after creation
activities.trigger: Change document created for OBJECTCLAS = MATERIAL

activities.name: Material Status Change
activities.description: Plant-specific material status (MARC.MMSTA) changed — affects availability for procurement/production
activities.trigger: CDPOS.FNAME = 'MMSTA' changed

activities.name: Material Deletion Flag Set
activities.description: Deletion flag set on material master to mark for decommission
activities.trigger: CDPOS change on MARA.LVORM or MARC.LVORM
